definition_of_done: Write organic-discovery-review.json with schema_version product_factory.organic_discovery_rendered_review.v1, reviewer_agent_id organic_discovery_review_agent, status verified, the current product_id and build_id, and reviewed_routes containing every declared public route exactly once.
Open every declared public route and verify unique visible title, heading, summary, evidence, CTA, and internal links.

When the reviewer sandbox cannot bind a preview port, use retained root-managed full-page screenshots and HTTP evidence only when the manifests record exact routes, viewports, rendered titles, headings, metadata, structured-data types, response statuses, and authorization outcomes.
Verify every approved visible claim resolves to organic-discovery.json evidence.
Verify authenticated and owner routes return noindex directives, require auth or permission, and are absent from sitemap.xml.
Verify canonical URLs, rendered structured data, sitemap, robots, OAI-SearchBot policy, and GPTBot policy match the contract.
Record every reviewed route and concrete blocking issue in organic-discovery-review.json.
Set decision to approved only with non-empty checks_passed, empty checks_failed, and no issues.
forbidden_scope: frontend source, product behavior, or strategy source; the independent reviewer reports defects but does not repair its own findings
approving unsupported customer, review, ranking, revenue, or performance claims
treating robots.txt as authentication or authorization
adding private routes to the sitemap
task.objective: Independently verify that rendered public pages answer researched customer intents with truthful evidence and that private product surfaces cannot enter search.
task.title: Review QuoteRivet public discovery and privacy boundaries
